title: UniWALM: Unified World Action Language Model for Embodied Robot Control
summary: Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a single shared representation, where each modality is both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. We ask: can jointly generating language enrich this shared representation, improving manipulation and supporting memory-dependent behavior? Unlike prior approaches that attach a reasoning or vision-language model to a video-action backbone and run them as distinct stages, UniWALM unifies all three modalities inside a single mixture-of-transformers backbone whose per-modality diffusion heads co-denoise synchronously, decoding subtask and textual memory in the same pass as action with no separate planning stage; the generated language is re-consumed on the next step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memory bank. To keep the action stream reliable under this richer objective, we further introduce Flow Matching with Correction (FMC), a training objective that teaches recovery from perturbed action trajectories at no inference-time cost. UniWALM consistently improves over same-backbone baselines (e.g., FastWAM) on compositional pick-and-place (MolmoSpaces) and across the memory-dependent subset of RMBench, where it reaches 34.5% without any pretrained language or reasoning model and exceeds Mem-0's keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using only a single anchor frame. On a real-world Find-the-Item task, generating textual memory lifts success from 11.1% to 61.1%, while state-of-the-art VLAs stay at or below chance (<=33.3%).
tldr: UniWALM introduces a unified world-action-language model that jointly generates video, action, and language in a single backbone, using language as a memory loop to improve manipulation and memory-dependent tasks without external planners, achieving significant real-world gains.
tldr_zh: UniWALM 提出了一种统一的世界-动作-语言模型，在单一骨干网络中联合生成视频、动作和语言，利用语言作为记忆循环来提升操作和依赖记忆的任务，无需外部规划器，并在真实世界中取得了显著改进。
summary_zh: 受人类跨语言、感知与行动整合经验的能力启发，我们提出了UniWALM——一个统一的世界-动作-语言模型，在单一共享表示中同时学习视频、动作与语言，其中每种模态既作为条件信号，又作为监督目标。我们提出如下问题：联合生成语言能否丰富这一共享表示，从而提升操作能力并支持依赖记忆的行为？与以往将推理模型或视觉-语言模型附加到视频-动作骨干网络上并以独立阶段运行的方法不同，UniWALM在单一混合Transformer骨干网络内部统一了全部三种模态，其各模态扩散头同步协同去噪，在与动作生成同一流程中解码子任务和文本记忆，无需独立的规划阶段；生成的语言在下一步中被重新消费，从而在不依赖外部规划器或记忆库的情况下形成语言即记忆的闭环。为了在更丰富的目标下保持动作流的可靠性，我们进一步引入了带校正的流匹配（Flow Matching with Correction, FMC）训练目标，该目标在不增加推理开销的前提下，训练模型从受扰动的动作轨迹中恢复。在组合式拾取-放置任务（MolmoSpaces）以及RMBench的记忆依赖子集上，UniWALM一致性地优于同骨干基线方法（如FastWAM）；在RMBench上，UniWALM在未使用任何预训练语言或推理模型的情况下达到34.5%的准确率，并仅凭单张锚定帧即超过了配备关键帧的Mem-0设置（28.5%）。在真实世界的物品查找任务中，生成文本记忆将成功率从11.1%提升至61.1%，而最先进的视觉-语言-动作模型仍停留在随机水平或以下（≤33.3%）。

title: Physical Canvas: A Vision Tactile World Model For Robot Policy Evaluation And Learning
summary: Evaluating and post-training robot policies through physical interaction is costly and difficult to scale, motivating action-conditioned world models as interactive simulators. However, visually plausible predictions can misrepresent contact dynamics, providing unreliable feedback for policy evaluation and learning. We introduce PhysCanvas, a state-consistent visuo-tactile world model for contact-rich robot manipulation. PhysCanvas unifies multi-view RGB, tactile images, marker displacement, task state, and actions within a unified vision space. All modalities share a video VAE and pretrained generative backbone, allowing optical touch to reuse visual and temporal priors. Motion images derived through forward kinematics and camera projection provide spatially aligned action conditioning, while an initial RGB anchor and updated reference observations guide sequential generation. Our consistency-aware post-training uses the frozen Scene Reward Model, Modality Reward Model, and State Reward Model to supervise scene preservation, visual-tactile compatibility, and agreement with real task outcomes. The resulting world model supports closed-loop policy rollouts for evaluation and provides imagined interactions and rewards for GRPO policy updates. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, when policies are rolled out in the world model, State Reward Model supervision increases the arithmetic mean of task-wise Pearson correlations between world-model and real-world success rates from 0.602 to 0.885. Policy post-training in the reward-guided world model further increases $π_{0.5}$'s mean real-world success rate from a 59.1% SFT baseline to 70.8%. These results demonstrate the value of unified multimodal modeling and consistency-aware post-training for robot policy evaluation and learning. Project page: https://zebinx.github.io/PhysCanvas_HomePage/.
tldr: PhysCanvas introduces a state-consistent visuo-tactile world model unifying multi-view RGB, tactile, and motion images in a shared vision space for contact-rich robot manipulation, enabling reliable policy evaluation and reward-guided post-training via GRPO. Across four real-world tasks, it improves world-model-to-real success correlation from 0.602 to 0.885 and boosts real-world success from 59.1% to 70.8%.
tldr_zh: PhysCanvas 提出一种状态一致的视觉-触觉世界模型，将多视角RGB、触觉和运动图像统一到共享视觉空间，支持接触丰富的机器人操作策略评估和基于奖励的GRPO后训练。在四个真实任务中，将世界模型与真实成功率的相关系数从0.602提升至0.885，真实成功率从59.1%提升至70.8%。
summary_zh: 通过物理交互来评估和训练机器人策略成本高昂且难以扩展，这促使我们将动作条件世界模型作为交互式仿真器。然而，视觉上看似合理的预测可能错误表征接触动力学，从而为策略评估和学习提供不可靠的反馈。我们提出了PhysCanvas，一种用于接触丰富的机器人操作任务的状态一致的视觉-触觉世界模型。PhysCanvas将多视角RGB图像、触觉图像、标记位移、任务状态和动作统一到同一视觉空间中。所有模态共享一个视频VAE和预训练生成骨干网络，使得光学触觉能够复用视觉和时间先验。通过前向运动学和相机投影得到的运动图像提供了空间对齐的动作条件，而初始RGB锚点和更新的参考观测则引导序列生成。我们的一致性感知后训练使用冻结的场景奖励模型、模态奖励模型和状态奖励模型，分别监督场景保持、视觉-触觉兼容性以及与真实任务结果的一致性。由此产生的世界模型支持闭环策略 rollout 用于评估，并为GRPO策略更新提供想象交互和奖励。在四个真实世界操作任务中，当策略在世界模型中 rollout 时，状态奖励模型监督将世界模型与真实世界成功率之间的任务级Pearson相关系数的算术平均值从0.602提升至0.885。在奖励引导的世界模型中进行策略后训练，进一步将\( \pi_{0.5} \)的平均真实世界成功率从59.1%的SFT基线提升至70.8%。这些结果证明了统一多模态建模和一致性感知后训练在机器人策略评估与学习中的价值。项目主页：https://zebinx.github.io/PhysCanvas_HomePage/。

title: SuperMimic: Scaling Humanoid Whole-Body Control with One Differentiable World Model
summary: Tracking large human-motion datasets has become the dominant route to general, expressive humanoid whole-body control, but scaling across many motions is expensive. Current pipelines use model-free reinforcement learning, either merging per-motion specialists through lossy distillation, or brute-forcing a single policy with cluster-scale compute. SuperMimic amortizes learning across all motions with one differentiable world model of their shared dynamics, fit from logged transitions of a standard rigid-body simulator. The world model and the tracking policy train together in one loop, and backpropagation-through-time over short imagined rollouts gives the policy analytic gradients. Fast imagined rollouts and analytic gradients make policy learning efficient. In 3 hours on a single GPU, SuperMimic surpasses the return of a state-of-the-art motion tracker baseline trained for 7 days on 128 GPUs. It reduces GPU-hours by more than $1000\times$ and fails on only 25 of 129,514 benchmark motions, versus 179 failures for the baseline. After 9.8 hours on two GPUs, SuperMimic achieves zero failures. From 1 to 264 hours of motion, the world model's prediction error stays stable, and GPU-hours to a target return grow slowly. Our policy transfers to a physical Unitree G1 across diverse and acrobatic motions. SuperMimic removes compute as the bottleneck to scaling humanoid whole-body control, making it practical to measure motion-tracking scaling laws.
tldr: SuperMimic scales humanoid whole-body control by training a single policy with one differentiable world model of shared dynamics, enabling analytic gradients via backpropagation-through-time, achieving over 1000x GPU-hour reduction and zero failures on a broad motion benchmark, with real-world Unitree G1 transfer.
tldr_zh: SuperMimic 通过使用一个可微分的共享动力学世界模型，结合短时想象轨迹的反向传播提供解析梯度，在单GPU上3小时超越大规模强化学习基线，大幅降低训练成本并实现真实机器人迁移。
summary_zh: 追踪大规模人体运动数据集已成为实现通用、富有表现力的人形全身控制的主要途径，但跨多种运动进行扩展成本高昂。现有流程采用无模型强化学习，要么通过有损蒸馏合并各运动专属策略，要么以大规模集群计算强行训练单一策略。SuperMimic利用一个可微分的共享动力学世界模型，将所有运动的学习过程摊销化，该模型基于标准刚体模拟器的日志转换数据进行拟合。世界模型与追踪策略在同一循环中联合训练，通过对短期想象轨迹的时间反向传播，为策略提供解析梯度。快速的想象轨迹展开与解析梯度使策略学习高效化。在单块GPU上仅需3小时，SuperMimic即可超越一个在最先进运动追踪基准上训练7天（使用128块GPU）的性能。其GPU耗时减少了超过1000倍，在129,514个基准动作中仅失败25个，而基线方法失败179个。在两块GPU上训练9.8小时后，SuperMimic实现零失败。在1至264小时的运动数据范围内，世界模型的预测误差保持稳定，达到目标回报所需的GPU耗时增长缓慢。我们的策略可迁移至物理实体Unitree G1，覆盖多样且高难度的杂技动作。SuperMimic消除了计算资源对扩展人形全身控制的瓶颈制约，使测量运动追踪扩展定律成为现实可行的任务。

title: Perceives but Doesn't Brake: A Perception-Action Binding Gap in Reasoning Driving VLAs
summary: Reasoning-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) driving models can perceive and reason about safety-critical hazards yet fail to translate that evidence into safe actions. We characterize this failure as a perception-action binding gap: hazard information is available inside the model but exerts insufficient control over trajectory generation. Using matched simulated counterfactuals and logged driving replay, we show that in-path hazards are actually encoded in the visual representation, but longitudinal plans are dominated by ego-speed history and respond only weakly to hazard proximity or the model's own reasoning trace. Further analysis shows that the trajectory generator is capable of braking but sometimes fails to do so due to the perception-action binding gap. Without retraining or modifying any weights, we inject a hazard-conditioned energy into the frozen flow-matching sampler of Alpamayo-1.5, restoring the missing coupling at generation time. With exact obstacle geometry, guidance cuts footprint intrusion from 58.1% to 14.5% and recovers safe braking whenever sufficient stopping distance remains, eliminating collisions entirely in our braking-relevant closed-loop battery. It also reverses the diagnosed dependence of the plan, from tracking ego speed to responding to obstacle range. These results separate hazard perception from hazard control in driving VLAs, show that unsafe behavior can arise even when the model has both the evidence and the ability to act on it, and propose a simple fix for bridging this binding gap.
tldr: The paper identifies a perception-action binding gap in reasoning driving VLAs, where hazard evidence is encoded but not used for safe braking, and proposes a training-free energy-based guidance method that restores safe braking in frozen flow-matching samplers.
tldr_zh: 本文揭示了推理型驾驶VLA中的感知-行动绑定差距：模型能感知危险但无法据此安全制动，并提出一种无需训练的基于能量的引导方法，在冻结的流匹配采样器中恢复安全制动。
summary_zh: 推理增强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）驾驶模型能够感知并推理安全关键性危险，却无法将这一证据转化为安全行动。我们将此失败表征为感知-行动绑定缺口：危险信息存在于模型内部，但对轨迹生成的调控不足。通过使用匹配的模拟反事实与录制的驾驶回放，我们表明路径内的危险实际上已被编码在视觉表征中，但纵向规划主要受自车速度历史主导，对危险接近程度或模型自身推理轨迹的响应十分微弱。进一步分析显示，轨迹生成器具备制动能力，但由于感知-行动绑定缺口，有时未能执行制动。在不进行重新训练或修改任何权重的情况下，我们向Alpamayo-1.5的冻结流匹配采样器中注入了一种危险条件能量，在生成阶段恢复了缺失的耦合。在具备精确障碍物几何信息的条件下，该引导将足迹侵入率从58.1%降低至14.5%，并在存在足够停车距离时恢复安全制动，完全消除了我们制动相关闭环测试组中的碰撞。同时，它还逆转了所诊断的规划依赖关系，从追踪自车速度转为响应障碍物距离。这些结果将驾驶VLA中的危险感知与危险控制分离开来，表明即使模型同时拥有证据和采取行动的能力，不安全行为仍可能出现，并提出了一种弥合该绑定缺口的简洁解决方案。

title: Reasoning as a Distribution: Generative Plan Latents for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies increasingly reason before acting, but existing reasoning models compress this intermediate decision into a single representation. When several plans are valid, this commitment hides alternatives that could otherwise be selected or revised. We introduce the Generative Plan Latent (GPL), which represents the reasoning state as a low-dimensional conditional distribution over plans, such as which object, grasp, or route to use. This makes the reasoning state addressable: without retraining the VLA, plans can be sampled (coverage), selected on request (steering), and reweighted by deployment outcomes (outcome adaptation). We test all three on SimplerEnv manipulation with $π_0$, and extend the analysis to RoboCasa, LIBERO, and a maze domain. Steering the plan raises the fraction of executions that follow the request from 0.48 to 0.94, while the same guidance on the native action distribution shows no reliable gain. Finally, we show that an explicit plan is most useful when it carries decision information not already determined by the observation.
tldr: This paper introduces Generative Plan Latents (GPL), a method that represents the reasoning state of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies as a low-dimensional distribution over plans, enabling sampling, steering, and reweighting of plans without retraining. Experiments on manipulation benchmarks show that steering plans significantly improves adherence to user requests compared to steering native action distributions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出生成式计划潜变量（GPL），将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的推理状态表示为计划上的低维分布，从而无需重新训练即可对计划进行采样、引导和按结果重新加权。在操作基准上的实验表明，引导计划比引导原生动作分布能显著提高遵循用户请求的比例。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略日益倾向于在行动之前进行推理，但现有的推理模型将这一中间决策压缩为单一表征。当多种方案均可行时，这种压缩会隐藏原本可以被选择或修正的替代方案。我们提出生成式方案潜在表征（GPL），将推理状态表示为方案上的低维条件分布，例如使用哪个物体、抓取方式或路径。这使得推理状态具有可寻址性：无需重新训练VLA，即可对方案进行采样（覆盖）、按需选择（引导），并根据部署结果重新加权（结果自适应）。我们在基于$π_0$的SimplerEnv操作任务中测试了以上全部三种能力，并将分析扩展至RoboCasa、LIBERO及一个迷宫领域。引导方案将遵循请求的执行比例从0.48提升至0.94，而对原生动作分布施加相同引导则未显示出可靠增益。最后，我们表明，当显式方案携带观察中尚未确定的决策信息时，其最为有用。

title: LaLa-World: Scaling Latent World Models with Natural Language Actions
summary: This paper shows that JEPA-style latent world models (LWMs) can learn across diverse domains and data sources by adopting the language-conditioned interface of video generation models. We establish this approach as an effective and efficient basis for planning with imagination and downstream policy fine-tuning. To this end, we introduce LaLa-World, a Language-conditioned Latent World model that learns from simulation and robot trajectories together with broader image and video data. Two designs make this work. First, we describe both numerical actions and visual changes in language, enabling joint training of a single future predictor across heterogeneous datasets. Second, we build the predictor on a language model, allowing it to interpret language conditions while predicting future latent states. The resulting predictor achieves higher average MPC planning performance than existing LWMs trained separately for each domain or task. Adding image and video data further improves average planning performance and robustness to action phrasing. In a matched comparison with an RAEv2-based video generation model baseline, LaLa-World reaches comparable planning performance with $6\times$ less training cost and $13.9\times$ faster planning. Beyond planning, the pretrained LaLa-World serves as an initialization for LaLa-Policy, which jointly predicts actions and future visual representations. LaLa-Policy performs competitively with Cosmos Policy on LIBERO and RoboCasa, with up to $5.5\times$ faster inference.
tldr: LaLa-World introduces a language-conditioned latent world model that learns from heterogeneous simulation, robot, and video data, achieving efficient MPC planning and serving as an initialization for a competitive action-prediction policy.
tldr_zh: LaLa-World 提出了一种以语言为条件的潜在世界模型，能从异构仿真、机器人和视频数据中学习，在 MPC 规划中高效表现，并作为竞争性动作预测策略的初始化。
summary_zh: 本文表明，采用视频生成模型的语言条件接口，JEPA风格潜在世界模型（LWMs）能够在多种领域和数据源中进行学习。我们确立该方法作为基于想象进行规划及后续策略微调的有效且高效的基础。为此，我们提出了LaLa-World——一个从仿真环境、机器人轨迹以及更广泛的图像和视频数据中学习的语言条件潜在世界模型。两项设计构成了本研究的关键。第一，我们以语言形式同时描述数值动作和视觉变化，从而能够在异构数据集上联合训练单一的未来源预测器。第二，我们将预测器构建在语言模型之上，使其在预测未来潜在状态的同时能够理解语言条件。所得到的预测器在平均MPC规划性能上优于在各个领域或任务上分别训练的现有LWM模型。引入图像和视频数据进一步提升了平均规划性能和对动作表述方式的鲁棒性。在与基于RAEv2的视频生成模型基线的匹配对比中，LaLa-World以少6倍的训练成本和快13.9倍的规划速度达到了相当的规划性能。除了规划之外，预训练的LaLa-World还可作为LaLa-Policy的初始化，后者联合预测动作和未来视觉表征。LaLa-Policy在LIBERO和RoboCasa基准上表现出与Cosmos Policy相当的性能，并在推理速度上提升了至多5.5倍。

title: Learning Adaptable Dexterous Skills via Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking
summary: Dexterous multi-finger hands hold promise to unlock diverse skills like functional grasps, in-hand reorientation, and dynamic handover that the human-designed world assumes, yet existing learning recipes force a trade-off. Goal-reaching reinforcement learning generalizes to arbitrary object poses but, lacking any human prior, converges to unnatural and unreliable finger strategies; motion tracking reproduces human-like behavior from a single clip but cannot deviate from it. We present AdaDex, a goal-conditioned RL framework that turns a single hand-object trajectory of a few seconds---from mocap data or HOI reconstruction from in-the-wild RGB(D) video---into an adaptable dexterous skill. At the core of AdaDex is Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking: a shared policy is trained on two populations of massively parallel environments: motion tracking environments trained with dense motion tracking objective, which instill the human prior from human motion; and generalization environments with noised initial states and goals and a sparse object-success reward, which force the skill to work far off the reference. From seconds of human motion per skill, the resulting policies can learn diverse adaptable dexterous skills, such as functional grasping, object reposing, in-hand reorientation with finger gaiting, and dynamic behaviors like throw-and-catch. Our method outperforms baselines in terms of generalization and functionality, and we demonstrate transfer across simulators and to the real world. Project page: https://yuxuank.com/AdaDex/.
tldr: AdaDex trains goal-conditioned RL policies for dexterous manipulation by combining motion tracking (to instill human priors) with generalization environments (to improve robustness to varied object poses/goals), enabling adaptable skills like grasping, reorientation, and throw-and-catch from a single human motion clip, with transfer to real hardware.
tldr_zh: AdaDex通过结合运动跟踪（注入人类先验）和泛化环境（提高对物体姿态/目标的鲁棒性）来训练目标条件强化学习策略，从单个人体运动片段中学习可适应的灵巧操作技能（如抓取、重定向和抛接），并迁移到真实硬件。
summary_zh: 灵巧多指手具有解锁多种技能的潜力，例如功能性抓取、手内重定向以及动态交接等人类设计世界所预设的操作能力，然而现有的学习范式不得不在这些能力之间做出权衡。面向目标达成的强化学习能够泛化至任意物体姿态，但由于缺乏人类先验知识，其收敛得到的指部策略往往不自然且不可靠；动作跟踪可以从单段演示片段中复现类人行为，却无法偏离该片段所规定的轨迹。我们提出AdaDex，一种目标条件化的强化学习框架，能够将数秒长的单条手-物交互轨迹——无论是来自动捕数据，还是从现实世界RGB(D)视频中重建的手-物交互信息——转化为可适应的灵巧技能。AdaDex的核心在于混合灵巧模仿机制：一个共享策略在两个大规模并行环境群体上训练——其一是采用稠密动作跟踪目标训练的运动跟踪环境，用于注入来自人类运动的人类先验；其二是具有带噪声的初始状态与目标以及稀疏物体成功奖励的泛化环境，用于迫使技能在远离参考轨迹的情况下依然有效。基于每个技能仅数秒的人类运动数据，所得到的策略能够学习多种可适应的灵巧技能，包括功能性抓取、物体重定位、带手指步态的手内重定向，以及诸如抛接等动态行为。我们的方法在泛化性和功能性方面均优于基线方法，并且我们展示了跨仿真器迁移以及向真实世界的迁移效果。项目主页：https://yuxuanku.com/AdaDex/。

title: AgenticRoboRL: Bringing Coding-Agent Post-Training to Agentic Robotics
summary: Agentic robotics systems combine planners with robot harnesses to perform complex manipulation tasks. Recent work improves these systems through better harnesses and external memory, but relies on powerful closed-source models as planners and does not improve the planners' own capabilities. In contrast, coding agents have improved substantially by post-training the model itself. We therefore investigate whether post-training can also improve robot planners. However, applying it across robot harnesses requires accommodating different execution mechanisms, including VLA skill invocation and control-code generation. To this end, we introduce AgenticRoboRL, a framework for post-training robot planners across different harnesses. The training recipe combines supervised fine-tuning with multi-turn reinforcement learning. To accommodate different execution mechanisms, harness-specific adapters connect recorded planner interactions with task outcomes, enabling a common RL training pipeline while keeping execution components fixed. On LIBERO-PRO, AgenticRoboRL raises the success rate of a 9B-parameter planner from 18.1% to 71.0% without external memory, approaching the 72.1% achieved by Codex (GPT-5.5) with external memory. These results demonstrate post-training as an effective approach for improving robot planners. We will release the framework and trained planner checkpoints.
tldr: This paper introduces AgenticRoboRL, a post-training framework for robot planners that combines SFT and multi-turn RL, improving a 9B planner's success rate on LIBERO-PRO from 18.1% to 71.0% without external memory.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了AgenticRoboRL，一个结合SFT和多轮RL的机器人规划器后训练框架，在LIBERO-PRO上将9B规划器的成功率从18.1%提升至71.0%，且无需外部记忆。
summary_zh: 代理式机器人系统将规划器与机器人操控装置相结合，以执行复杂的操作任务。近期工作通过改进操控装置和外部记忆提升了这些系统的性能，但仍依赖强大的闭源模型作为规划器，并未提升规划器自身的能力。相比之下，编码智能体通过对模型本身进行后训练取得了显著进步。因此，我们研究后训练是否同样能够提升机器人规划器的性能。然而，跨操控装置应用后训练需要适配不同的执行机制，包括VLA技能调用和控制代码生成。为此，我们提出了AgenticRoboRL，一个用于跨不同操控装置对机器人规划器进行后训练的框架。该训练方案结合了监督微调与多轮强化学习。为适配不同的执行机制，我们设计了面向操控装置的适配器，将记录的规划器交互与任务结果相连接，从而在保持执行组件固定的前提下实现统一的强化学习训练流程。在LIBERO-PRO基准上，AgenticRoboRL将参数量为90亿的规划器成功率从18.1%提升至71.0%，且无需外部记忆，接近配备外部记忆的Codex（GPT-5.5）所达到的72.1%。这些结果表明，后训练是提升机器人规划器性能的有效途径。我们将发布该框架及训练后的规划器检查点。

title: CoGaussian: Open-Vocabulary Gaussian-based Collaborative 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Collaborative perception enables agents to retrieve the scene semantics and geometry beyond the field of view of any individual agent. This broader scene understanding enhances transportation safety and improves efficiency in multi-robot systems. However, existing collaborative semantic occupancy methods rely on dense 3D voxel annotations and are limited to recognizing objects within a predefined set of semantic classes. To overcome these limitations, we present CoGaussian, an open-vocabulary Gaussian-based collaborative semantic occupancy prediction framework. CoGaussian represents a scene as a set of foundation model-aligned sparse 3D Gaussians, which serve as a compact representation for communicating and fusing geometric and semantic information across multiple agents. On the Semantic-OPV2V benchmark, our method outperforms existing open-vocabulary single-agent approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of open-vocabulary collaborative scene understanding.
tldr: CoGaussian introduces an open-vocabulary collaborative perception framework using sparse 3D Gaussians aligned with foundation models to fuse geometric and semantic information across agents, outperforming single-agent methods on Semantic-OPV2V.
tldr_zh: CoGaussian 提出了一种开放词汇的协作感知框架，利用与基础模型对齐的稀疏 3D 高斯表示，在多智能体间融合几何与语义信息，在 Semantic-OPV2V 基准上优于单智能体方法。
summary_zh: 协同感知使智能体能够获取超出任何单一智能体视野范围的场景语义与几何信息。这种更广泛的场景理解能力增强了交通安全性，并提升了多机器人系统的运行效率。然而，现有的协同语义占据方法依赖于稠密的3D体素标注，且仅限于识别预定义语义类别集合中的物体。为克服这些局限，我们提出了CoGaussian——一种基于高斯分布的开词汇协同语义占据预测框架。CoGaussian将场景表示为一组与基础模型对齐的稀疏3D高斯分布，这些高斯分布作为紧凑的表示形式，用于多智能体间几何与语义信息的通信与融合。在Semantic-OPV2V基准上，我们的方法优于现有的开词汇单智能体方法，凸显了开词汇协同场景理解的有效性。

title: VLM-Guided Contact Retargeting and Generative Partner Modeling for Humanoid-Human Interaction
summary: Humanoid-human interaction requires robots to operate under severe partial observability: during close physical contact, the human partner is occluded, truncated, or outside the robot's field of view, causing pose estimation to fail and often necessitating external tracking or privileged human state. At the same time, heavy mutual occlusions introduce errors into the human-human motion-capture data used for learning. We present REACT, a framework for learning deployable humanoid-human interaction policies from human-human demonstrations. REACT treats semantic contact structure as the key supervisory signal connecting demonstration processing, interaction learning, and onboard control. First, a VLM-guided contact modeling and retargeting pipeline identifies semantically meaningful contacts and transfers them onto humanoid-human geometry while preserving interaction structure. Using these annotations, privileged interaction policies learn physically grounded behaviors through interaction-aware contact rewards and are then distilled into deployable egocentric depth policies trained entirely from onboard sensing using photorealistic human depth rendering. To address severe partial observability, we introduce generative partner-state modeling objectives that predict partner motion from occluded egocentric views. We evaluate REACT in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid across five contact-rich interactions. Semantic contact modeling substantially improves preservation of demonstrated interactions, while generative partner-state modeling improves contact recall on four of five interactions, most under heavy occlusion. On real hardware, REACT performs all five interactions using onboard sensing alone.
tldr: REACT introduces a VLM-guided contact retargeting pipeline and generative partner-state modeling to learn deployable humanoid-human interaction policies from human demonstrations, achieving all five contact-rich interactions on a real Unitree G1 using only onboard sensing.
tldr_zh: REACT 提出了一种基于VLM引导的接触重定向和生成式伙伴状态建模方法，从人类演示中学习可部署的人形机器人-人类交互策略，并仅在板载感知下在真实 Unitree G1 上完成了五种接触丰富的交互。
summary_zh: 人形机器人与人交互要求机器人在严重部分可观测条件下工作：在紧密身体接触期间，人类伙伴往往被遮挡、截断或超出机器人的视野范围，导致姿态估计失败，通常需要外部追踪或依赖特权化的人体状态信息。与此同时，严重的相互遮挡会给用于学习的人-人运动捕捉数据引入误差。我们提出REACT，一个从人-人演示中学习可部署人形机器人-人交互策略的框架。REACT将语义接触结构视为连接演示处理、交互学习与机载控制的关键监督信号。首先，一个基于视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的接触建模与重定向流程识别具有语义意义的接触，并将其迁移到人形机器人-人几何模型上，同时保持交互结构不变。利用这些标注，特权交互策略通过交互感知的接触奖励学习物理上合理的行为，随后通过逼真人体深度渲染，将策略蒸馏为完全依赖机载感知的可部署自我中心深度策略。为应对严重的部分可观测性，我们引入生成式伙伴状态建模目标，从被遮挡的自我中心视角预测伙伴运动。我们在仿真环境和真实Unitree G1人形机器人上评估了REACT在五种高接触交互中的表现。语义接触建模显著提升了对演示交互结构的保真度，而生成式伙伴状态建模在五种交互中的四种（多数处于严重遮挡条件下）改善了接触召回率。在真实硬件上，REACT仅依靠机载感知即可完成全部五种交互。

title: CLOSER: Evidence-Aware Active Visual Verification for Embodied Object-Goal Navigation
summary: Object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) requires an embodied agent to find an instance of a specified category in an unseen environment and stop near it. The agent typically relies on an object detector but must judge online from a limited egocentric video stream, sometimes a single frame, whether a detected candidate is the target. Detectors often confidently mistake similar objects, such as a sofa for a bed, and stopping at a false positive fails the episode. Prevailing systems also approach candidates greedily, leaving them occluded or partially observed. We present CLOSER, an evidence-aware active verification framework that treats stopping as closed-loop evidence acquisition, coupling vision-language model (VLM) verification with active perception. CLOSER fine-tunes an open-source VLM to label each view of a candidate tracked across frames as target, non-target, or uncertain, selects complementary views with an embedding-based diversity gate, and fuses their per-view probabilities with a lightweight network. If the fused judgment remains uncertain, a diffusion policy drives the agent toward the candidate using only the tracked mask and depth until the decision becomes decisive. CLOSER runs locally and plugs into existing ObjectNav systems without retraining them. On Gibson and Habitat-Matterport 3D, it raises average success rate by 3.6 points and success weighted by path length by 2.0 points, showing that verifying evidence before committing improves embodied navigation.
tldr: CLOSER introduces an evidence-aware active visual verification framework for embodied object-goal navigation, coupling fine-tuned VLM per-view verification with active perception and a diffusion-driven policy to reduce false positives and improve navigation success.
tldr_zh: CLOSER 提出了一种用于具身目标导航的证据感知主动视觉验证框架，结合微调 VLM 的逐视图验证、主动感知和扩散驱动策略，以减少误检并提高导航成功率。
summary_zh: 目标导航（ObjectNav）要求具身智能体在未知环境中找到指定类别的实例并在其附近停下。智能体通常依赖目标检测器，但必须从有限的以自我为中心的实时视频流中——有时是单帧图像——在线判断检测到的候选对象是否为目标。检测器常常自信地将相似物体混淆，如将沙发误认为床，而在假阳性处停下会导致该轮任务失败。现有系统通常也以贪婪方式接近候选对象，导致其被遮挡或仅被部分观察。我们提出CLOSER，一种证据感知的主动验证框架，将停止决策视为闭环证据采集过程，将视觉语言模型（VLM）验证与主动感知相结合。CLOSER对开源VLM进行微调，以对跨帧跟踪的候选对象的每一视角标注为目标、非目标或不确定，通过基于嵌入的多样性门控选择互补视角，并利用轻量级网络融合各视角的概率。若融合判断仍不确定，扩散策略仅利用跟踪掩码和深度信息驱动智能体靠近候选对象，直至决策变得明确。CLOSER可本地运行，并可直接嵌入现有ObjectNav系统而无需重新训练。在Gibson和Habitat-Matterport 3D数据集上，CLOSER将平均成功率提升3.6个百分点，按路径长度加权的成功率提升2.0个百分点，表明在做出停止决策前验证证据能够改善具身导航性能。

title: Fast Motion Retargeting Pipeline for Scalable Humanoid Robot Learning
summary: While large-scale human motion capture datasets provide a rich source of demonstrations for humanoid robot learning, retargeting the diverse motions to different humanoid robots remains a nontrivial challenge. Existing kinodynamic trajectory optimization pipelines are computationally expensive and often require manual adjustments per motion. We present FRDV (Fast Retargeting with Dynamics Validation), a scalable framework consisting of rapid constrained kinematic retargeting and an additional dynamics validation pipeline. Its kinematic stage integrates a custom Sequential Quadratic Programming solver, Real-Time Iteration, and parallel chunk-based processing, achieving up to 9,156 frames per second, approximately up to 136 times faster than GMR and ProtoMotions, while robot-specific constraints are incorporated into the optimization to reduce common retargeting artifacts, such as ground penetration and self-collision. For motions requiring additional verification, a contact implicit iLQR controller is utilized to test the retargeted reference under full rigid body dynamics. This dynamics-based validation identifies dynamically infeasible motions and refines contact-related artifacts such as foot floating and foot skating. We evaluate retargeting quality by training motion tracking reinforcement learning policies using several state-of-the-art pipelines and comparing their tracking fidelity and success rates. Furthermore, sim-to-real transfer is demonstrated on a Unitree G1 humanoid. Videos and code are available at: https://daroslab.github.io/frdv/.
tldr: FRDV is a scalable motion retargeting pipeline for humanoid robots, featuring fast kinematic retargeting with dynamics validation to ensure physical feasibility and enable sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: FRDV 是一个可扩展的人形机器人运动重定向流程，通过快速运动学重定向和动力学验证确保物理可行性，并实现仿真到现实的迁移。
summary_zh: 虽然大规模人体运动捕捉数据集为人形机器人学习提供了丰富的示范来源，但将这些多样化动作重定向到不同的人形机器人上仍是一项不小的挑战。现有的动力学与运动学轨迹优化流程计算成本高，且通常需要针对每个动作进行手动调整。我们提出了FRDV（带动力学验证的快速重定向），这是一个可扩展的框架，由快速约束运动学重定向和附加的动力学验证流程组成。其运动学阶段集成了自定义序列二次规划求解器、实时迭代和基于块的并行处理，实现了每秒高达9,156帧的处理速度，比GMR和ProtoMotions快约136倍，同时将机器人特定约束纳入优化中，以减少常见的重定向伪影，如地面穿透和自碰撞。对于需要额外验证的动作，我们利用接触隐式iLQR控制器在完整刚体动力学下测试重定向后的参考轨迹。这种基于动力学的验证能够识别动力学上不可行的动作，并修正与接触相关的伪影，如脚漂浮和脚滑动。我们通过使用多种最新流程训练运动跟踪强化学习策略，并比较其跟踪保真度和成功率来评估重定向质量。此外，还在Unitree G1人形机器人上展示了从仿真到实际部署的迁移效果。视频和代码可在以下网址获取：https://daroslab.github.io/frdv/。

title: GPT-6-Astra Understands Touch and Outperform Vision--Tactile--Language--Action Models
summary: General-purpose multimodal models have shown promise as direct robot action policies, yet whether they grasp the physics underlying real-world interactions and can apply that understanding to guide action remains underexplored. We investigate this question using contact-rich manipulation as a representative testbed, examining tactile understanding as a concrete instance of this broader capability. Contact-rich manipulation requires interpreting tactile feedback and adjusting actions after obstruction. Existing learned tactile policies acquire these capabilities through specialized pretraining and per-task optimization, with substantial data and training costs. We present GPT-as-Tactile-Policy, which summarizes expert demonstrations into task guidance and tactile references for contact assessment and corrective action. GPT-6-Astra combines this context with multimodal observations and interaction history to generate control commands and adjust actions through contact feedback. Without additional robotics-specific pretraining or per-task policy fine-tuning, our method achieves 93.8\% mean success across five UniVTAC tasks. Overall performance is comparable to state-of-the-art policies, with higher success on selected tasks. On Insert Hole, tactile feedback improves success from 31\% to 99\%. Execution analysis further demonstrates contact-guided probing and correction, supporting manipulation progress through explicit expert experience and online feedback.
tldr: The paper proposes GPT-as-Tactile-Policy, using GPT-6-Astra with tactile feedback and expert demonstrations to control contact-rich manipulation tasks, achieving competitive success rates without task-specific fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了GPT-as-Tactile-Policy，利用GPT-6-Astra结合触觉反馈和专家演示来控制接触丰富的操作任务，无需特定任务微调即达到竞争性成功率。
summary_zh: 通用多模态模型在直接作为机器人动作策略方面展现出潜力，但它们是否真正理解现实世界交互背后的物理规律，并能否应用这种理解来指导动作，仍是一个尚未充分探究的问题。我们以接触丰富的操作为代表性测试平台，将触觉理解视为这一更广泛能力的具体实例来研究该问题。接触丰富的操作要求解读触觉反馈，并在遇到阻碍后调整动作。现有的基于学习的触觉策略通过专门的预训练和逐任务优化来获取这些能力，需要大量的数据和训练成本。我们提出了GPT-as-Tactile-Policy方法，将专家演示总结为任务指导和触觉参考，用于接触评估和纠正动作。GPT-6-Astra将这一上下文与多模态观测和交互历史相结合，生成控制命令并通过接触反馈调整动作。在无需额外机器人专用预训练或逐任务策略微调的情况下，我们的方法在五个UniVTAC任务上实现了93.8%的平均成功率。整体性能与最先进策略相当，在选定任务上成功率更高。在插孔任务中，触觉反馈将成功率从31%提升至99%。执行分析进一步展示了接触引导的探测和纠正，通过明确的专家经验和在线反馈支持操作进程。

title: Plausible Future, Wrong Choice: Steering World-Action Models toward Intended Future
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied generalist policies by jointly modeling future world evolution and robot actions across diverse manipulation tasks. However, representing diverse futures is only the first step: a capable WAM must also generate futures that match the requirements of the current task and execution progress. In long-horizon manipulation where similar observation-action segments occur across different tasks and stages, existing approaches may generate locally plausible yet misdirected rollouts to drift toward wrong task stage, i.e., a phenomenon we term Stage Confusion. To address this problem, we propose TaskWAM, a closed-loop, stage-aware framework that represents fine-grained task requirements with Mode Tokens and tracks execution progress with State Tokens, forming a structured task state to steer world--action generation toward intended future. We further introduce StageBench, a controlled multi-stage manipulation benchmark with parameterized stage variations and automated evaluation.Extensive experiments on both simulation benchmarks and real-world tasks demonstrate that TaskWAM effectively reduces confusion and achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods. Moreover, TaskWAM provides strong plug-and-play transfer across heterogeneous WAM architectures and robot embodiments, including single-arm robots, dual-arm grippers, dexterous hands, and humanoid robots.
tldr: TaskWAM introduces a stage-aware framework with Mode Tokens and State Tokens to steer World-Action Models toward task-consistent futures, mitigating stage confusion in long-horizon manipulation, and demonstrates plug-and-play transfer across embodiments.
tldr_zh: TaskWAM通过模式令牌和状态令牌构成结构化任务状态，引导世界-动作模型生成符合任务意图的未来，缓解长时程操纵中的阶段混淆，并展示跨异构模型与机器人本体的即插即用迁移能力。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过联合建模多样操作任务中的未来世界演化与机器人动作，已成为具身通用策略的一种有前景的范式。然而，表征多样的未来仅是第一步：一个能力完备的WAM还必须生成与当前任务及执行进度要求相匹配的未来。在长时程操作中，不同任务和阶段常出现相似的观测-动作片段，现有方法可能生成局部合理但方向错误的推演，从而漂移至错误的任务阶段——我们将这一现象称为“阶段混淆”。为解决该问题，我们提出TaskWAM，一种闭环、阶段感知的框架，通过模式令牌（Mode Tokens）表征细粒度任务需求，并以状态令牌（State Tokens）追踪执行进度，形成结构化的任务状态，以引导世界-动作生成朝向预期未来。我们进一步引入StageBench，一个带有参数化阶段变化和自动化评估的可控多阶段操作基准。在仿真基准和真实世界任务上的大量实验表明，TaskWAM有效减少了混淆，并在性能上与最先进方法相当。此外，TaskWAM在异质WAM架构及机器人本体之间展现出强大的即插即用迁移能力，涵盖单臂机器人、双臂夹爪、灵巧手及人形机器人。

title: SPAR: Search-trained Push Action Ranker for Efficient Navigation Among Movable Obstacles
summary: Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO) requires a robot to rearrange objects that block access to its goal. For a pushing robot, progress may depend on a setup push that enables a later opening without itself clearing a passage. The number of candidate sequences can grow exponentially with sequence length, making physics-based search costly. We introduce the Search-trained Push Action Ranker (SPAR), which learns to prioritize push primitives from simulated search outcomes. Searches over sequences of up to two pushes per object provide supervision that distinguishes immediate openings from setup pushes. A transformer trained with regression and ranking losses scores primitives using contact tokens conditioned on scene geometry and reachability regions. The same model guides simulator evaluations in SPAR Search and selects actions for direct execution in SPAR Policy. Both modes solve successive keyhole problems that open access to neighboring free-space regions within a NAMO planner. Across successful runs on $300$ simulated two-push keyhole problems, SPAR Search reduces median simulator calls by $7.0\times$, leading to a $3.8\times$ reduction in planning time relative to Random Search. Without retraining, the same ranker guides search on $600$ keyhole problems which have no solution within two pushes. At a depth limit of five pushes, SPAR Search achieves $50.7\%$ success within $100$ simulator calls, compared with $20.2\%$ for Random Search. These gains carry over to NAMO planning: on hard simulated scenes, SPAR Search achieves $47\%$ success within $100$ simulator calls, compared with $21\%$ for Random Search. In real-robot experiments, SPAR Policy succeeds in $37/40$ trials without a physics-based digital twin, compared with $33/40$ for SPAR Search and $27/40$ for Random Search.
tldr: SPAR introduces a learning-based push action ranker trained on search outcomes to efficiently solve Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO), reducing planning time and improving success rates in simulated and real robot experiments.
tldr_zh: SPAR 提出了一种基于搜索训练结果的推动作排序器，用于高效解决可移动障碍物导航问题，在仿真和真实机器人实验中减少了规划时间并提高了成功率。
summary_zh: 在可移动障碍物间导航（NAMO）要求机器人重新排列阻挡其到达目标的物体。对于推式机器人，进展可能依赖于一次设置性推动，该推动使后续的开口成为可能，而本身并未清通路径。候选序列的数量可能随序列长度呈指数增长，使得基于物理的搜索代价高昂。我们引入了搜索训练推动动作排序器（SPAR），它从模拟搜索结果中学习优先排序推动原语。对每个物体最多两次推动的序列进行搜索所提供的监督信号，能够区分即时开口与设置性推动。一个通过回归损失和排序损失训练的Transformer模型，利用基于场景几何和可达区域条件化的接触标记对原语进行评分。同一模型在SPAR搜索中指导模拟器评估，并在SPAR策略中直接选择动作执行。两种模式均能解决连续的关键孔问题，这些问题为NAMO规划器内的相邻自由空间区域打开通路。在$300$个模拟两推关键孔问题的成功运行中，SPAR搜索将模拟器调用次数中位数减少了$7.0\times$，相较于随机搜索，规划时间减少了$3.8\times$。在不重新训练的情况下，同一个排序器在$600$个两推内无解的关键孔问题上引导搜索。在五推深度限制下，SPAR搜索在$100$次模拟器调用内达到$50.7\%$的成功率，而随机搜索为$20.2\%$。这些增益延续至NAMO规划：在困难的模拟场景中，SPAR搜索在$100$次模拟器调用内达到$47\%$的成功率，而随机搜索为$21\%$。在真实机器人实验中，SPAR策略在$40$次试验中成功$37$次，且无需基于物理的数字孪生模型，而SPAR搜索为$33/40$，随机搜索为$27/40$。

title: Large Multimodal Models for Direct Robot Control: GPT-6 as a Beginning
summary: Recent advances in visuospatial understanding and agentic reasoning enable direct robotic manipulation with general-purpose multimodal models, but their embodied capabilities remain poorly understood. This paper systematically evaluate GPT-6 Astra for closed-loop robotic manipulation using a lightweight agent execution framework. We first probe three fundamental embodied capabilities-depth perception, embodied in-context learning, and tactile understanding-and demonstrate that the model can exploit depth information, acquire simple manipulation strategies from contextual demonstrations, and use tactile feedback to correct its actions. We then evaluate GPT-6 Astra across five established manipulation benchmarks along six capability dimensions. Despite competitive performance on several benchmarks-26.92\% success on RoboDojo and 76.0\% on RoboTwin 2.0-our analysis reveals a pronounced gap between semantic reasoning and physical execution, particularly in consequence-aware action planning, precision, and complex motion coordination. To further examine these limitations, we introduce LIBERO-GeoMotion, a new benchmark of geometry-constrained tasks that require precise pose alignment, coordinated translation and rotation, and anticipation of physical action consequences. GPT-6 Astra achieves only 11.1\% zero-shot success, exposing the difficulty of translating spatial understanding into physically feasible motion. Real-world experiments corroborate these findings: zero-shot execution is feasible for simple tasks, yet persistent deficits remain in motion feasibility, precise control, and physical safety, while substantial inference latency further hinders practical deployment. Overall, our results characterize the emerging embodied capabilities of general-purpose multimodal models and delineate the key challenges toward safe, efficient, and reliable robotic manipulation.
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates GPT-6 Astra, a general-purpose multimodal model, for closed-loop robotic manipulation across benchmarks and real-world tasks, revealing a gap between semantic reasoning and physical execution and introducing the LIBERO-GeoMotion benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文系统评估了通用多模态模型GPT-6 Astra在闭环机器人操作中的表现，通过多个基准和真实实验揭示了语义推理与物理执行之间的差距，并提出了LIBERO-GeoMotion基准。
summary_zh: 近期在视觉空间理解与智能体推理方面的进展，使得借助通用多模态模型实现直接机器人操作成为可能，但这些模型在具身层面的能力仍未被充分理解。本文利用轻量级智能体执行框架，系统评估了GPT-6 Astra在闭环机器人操作中的表现。我们首先探究了三项基础具身能力——深度感知、具身在上下文中学习以及触觉理解——并证明该模型能够利用深度信息、从上下文演示中习得简单操作策略，并借助触觉反馈修正自身动作。随后，我们在五个既有操作基准上，沿六个能力维度对GPT-6 Astra进行了评估。尽管在若干基准上表现出竞争力——在RoboDojo上成功率达26.92%，在RoboTwin 2.0上为76.0%——但我们的分析揭示出语义推理与物理执行之间存在显著差距，尤其在结果感知的动作规划、精确性以及复杂运动协调方面。为进一步探究这些局限，我们引入了LIBERO-GeoMotion，这是一个全新的几何约束任务基准，要求精准的位姿对齐、平移与旋转的协调配合，以及对物理动作后果的预判。GPT-6 Astra在该基准上的零样本成功率仅为11.1%，暴露出将空间理解转化为物理可行动作的困难。真实世界实验也证实了上述发现：零样本执行在简单任务中可行，但在运动可行性、精确控制及物理安全方面仍存在持续不足，同时较大的推理延迟进一步阻碍了实际部署。总体而言，本研究刻画了通用多模态模型新兴的具身能力，并指出了实现安全、高效、可靠的机器人操作所面临的关键挑战。

title: From Predictive Geometry to Action: Learning Complementary Predictive Representations for Embodied Manipulation
summary: Effective manipulation requires a policy to capture not only about the current scene geometry, but also about how that geometry will evolve under interaction. Existing approaches either augment policies with geometric information from current observations or introduce future prediction as auxiliary supervision, leaving open how predictive geometry should be represented for action generation. Therefore, we propose a two-stage framework, which learns complementary predictive representations from multi-view video clips. During pretraining, a frozen 3D foundation model provides dense geometric features that are compressed into predictive geometric representations and optimized to preserve scene structure and its temporal evolution. Action supervision is then applied to geometric transitions to extract a complementary motor representation that emphasizes action-relevant transitions. During downstream post-training, predictive geometry is transferred through geometry queries, while the motor representation guides intermediate features along the action-generation pathway. Future observations are used only as privileged supervision during training and are not required at inference time. Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, SimplerEnv, and real-world bimanual and single-arm tasks, our approach consistently improves downstream policies, including an absolute gain of 10.4 percentage points on the WidowX evaluation. We further demonstrate transfer across multiple VLA architectures and WAMs, with improvements in both future-world and action prediction. The code will be available at https://github.com/xuxiaoxxxx/CPR.
tldr: This paper proposes a two-stage framework that learns complementary predictive representations from multi-view video for embodied manipulation, transferring predictive geometry and motor representations to improve downstream policies across multiple benchmarks and real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个两阶段框架，从多视角视频中学习互补的预测表示，并将预测几何和运动表示迁移到下游策略中，在多个基准和真实机器人上提升操作性能。
summary_zh: 有效的操控需要一个策略，不仅要捕捉当前场景的几何信息，还要捕捉该几何结构在交互作用下将如何演化。现有方法要么通过当前观测来增强策略的几何信息，要么引入未来预测作为辅助监督，但对于动作生成而言，预测性几何应如何表示仍是一个未解问题。为此，我们提出了一种两阶段框架，从多视角视频片段中学习互补的预测表示。在预训练阶段，一个冻结的3D基础模型提供密集的几何特征，这些特征被压缩为预测性几何表示，并经过优化以保留场景结构及其时间演化。随后，对几何转换施加动作监督，以提取一种互补的运动表示，强调与动作相关的转换。在下游后训练阶段，预测性几何通过几何查询进行传递，而运动表示则沿着动作生成路径引导中间特征。未来观测仅在训练期间作为特权监督使用，推理时不再需要。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、SimplerEnv以及真实世界的双臂和单臂任务中，我们的方法持续提升了下游策略的性能，包括在WidowX评估中绝对提高了10.4个百分点。我们进一步展示了在多种VLA架构和WAM上的迁移能力，在未来世界预测和动作预测方面均有改进。代码将在 https://github.com/xuxiaoxxxx/CPR 公开。

title: De-Diffusing WAMs: Action-Sufficient Direct Prediction for Robot Control
summary: Cascade world-action models (WAMs) use predicted visual futures to condition robot actions, but inherit costly iterative inference from diffusion-pretrained experts. We ask what a single-step predicted future must preserve to support accurate single-step action prediction. In the evaluated WAM, resampling video noise has little effect on downstream actions, yet naively truncating both streams to one step substantially reduces task success. Video-space supervision only partially closes this gap, and a local sensitivity analysis shows that vision prediction errors have highly unequal consequences for action accuracy. These findings motivate DirectWAM, which converts pretrained video and action experts into single-step predictors without stochastic sampling through action-sufficient distillation, while retaining the explicit future-to-action cascade. After learning a one-step action model, we train the future predictor by decoding actions from its own predicted futures and backpropagating demonstration action error through the expert, with an optional future-latent reconstruction loss. The resulting objective evaluates the student-generated future through its downstream control consequences rather than relying on representation matching alone. DirectWAM achieves 97.1% average success across four LIBERO suites and 85.4% on RoboTwin 2.0, outperforming Flash-WAM at the same one-evaluation-per-stream budget. This advantage has also extended to three real-world tasks that we designed. Compared with the full iterative teacher, it reduces inference latency by $28.0\times$.
tldr: This paper introduces DirectWAM, a method that converts pretrained cascade world-action models into single-step predictors via action-sufficient distillation, achieving high task success on LIBERO and RoboTwin benchmarks with dramatically reduced inference latency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DirectWAM，通过动作充分蒸馏将预训练的级联世界动作模型转化为单步预测器，在LIBERO和RoboTwin基准上实现了高任务成功率，并大幅降低了推理延迟。
summary_zh: 级联世界动作模型（WAMs）利用预测的视觉未来状态来调节机器人动作，但继承自扩散预训练专家的昂贵迭代推理过程。我们探讨的是，单步预测的未来状态需要保留哪些信息，才能支持准确的单步动作预测。在评估的WAM中，重采样视频噪声对下游动作影响甚微，然而将两个流均截断为单步则会显著降低任务成功率。视频空间监督仅部分弥合了这一差距，且局部敏感性分析表明，视觉预测误差对动作准确性的影响高度不均。这些发现催生了DirectWAM，它将预训练的视频专家和动作专家转化为单步预测器，无需通过动作充分蒸馏进行随机采样，同时保留了显式的未来到动作级联结构。在学习单步动作模型之后，我们通过从自身预测的未来状态中解码动作，并将示范动作误差通过专家反向传播来训练未来预测器，并辅以可选的未来潜在重建损失。由此产生的目标函数通过下游控制后果来评估学生生成的未来状态，而非仅依赖表征匹配。DirectWAM在四个LIBERO套件中达到97.1%的平均成功率，在RoboTwin 2.0上达到85.4%，在相同每流单次评估预算下优于Flash-WAM。该优势也已扩展至我们设计的三项真实世界任务。与完整的迭代教师模型相比，推理延迟降低了28.0倍。

title: FIT-MAC: A Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Framework for Robust Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance on standard robotic manipulation benchmarks. However, their reliability can degrade substantially when task conditions deviate from the nominal setting. Perturbations in object positions and task instructions may lead to complete task failure. Existing VLA policies generally lack an explicit runtime mechanism for distinguishing these failure modes and selecting an appropriate recovery strategy. To systematically mitigate this issue, we propose FIT-MAC, a failure-aware, closed-loop multi-agent control framework for improving the robustness of VLA policies at inference time. FIT-MAC augments a VLA policy with an inference-time control layer. First, the Planner Agent parses the language instruction into a structured task specification that captures the manipulation goal and spatial constraints, and the Grounder Agent resolves each instruction-level reference to a visual target. Next, the Verifier Agent tracks phase-specific execution progress, distinguishes target-binding errors from local execution failures, and determines whether intervention is warranted. The Correction Agent then routes permitted interventions to target rebinding or bounded grasping or placement recovery, depending on the failure type. When no intervention is required, the pretrained VLA remains the default action generator. Extensive experiments on LIBERO-PRO demonstrate that FIT-MAC improves robustness across multiple VLA backbones, consistently increasing success rates and achieving state-of-the-art performance under diverse perturbations.
tldr: FIT-MAC introduces a failure-aware, closed-loop multi-agent framework that augments VLA policies at inference time with planner, grounder, verifier, and correction agents, improving robustness on LIBERO-PRO under perturbations.
tldr_zh: FIT-MAC提出了一种故障感知的闭环多智能体框架，在推理时为VLA策略增加规划、落地、验证和修正智能体，在LIBERO-PRO扰动下提升鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在标准机器人操作基准测试中表现出色。然而，当任务条件偏离标称设置时，其可靠性可能大幅下降。物体位置和任务指令的扰动可能导致任务完全失败。现有VLA策略通常缺乏显式的运行时机制来区分这些失败模式并选择合适的恢复策略。为系统性地缓解这一问题，我们提出了FIT-MAC，一种面向失败感知的闭环多智能体控制框架，旨在提升VLA策略在推理时的鲁棒性。FIT-MAC为VLA策略增补了一个推理时控制层。首先，规划智能体将语言指令解析为结构化任务规范，以捕捉操作目标和空间约束；接地智能体则将每个指令级指称解析为视觉目标。接下来，验证智能体跟踪各阶段的执行进度，区分目标绑定错误与局部执行失败，并判断是否需要干预。随后，纠偏智能体根据失败类型，将允许的干预路由至目标重新绑定、有界抓取或放置恢复。当无需干预时，预训练的VLA保持为默认动作生成器。在LIBERO-PRO上的大量实验表明，FIT-MAC在多种VLA骨干网络上均能提升鲁棒性，持续提高成功率，并在多种扰动下实现最先进的性能。

title: PACT-VLA: Speculative Action-Chunk Verification with Pre-Commit Observations
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are commonly deployed with asynchronous inference in real-world settings, where the next action chunk is generated while the robot is still executing the previous one. By the time the new chunk is committed, the robot and scene have changed, so the chunk is conditioned on a stale observation and task success drops sharply as this inference delay grows. Generating multiple candidate chunks could let newer observations inform the final choice, but existing multi-candidate methods either rank candidates with the stale inference-start observation or repeatedly switch between candidates during execution, which can make the executed action sequence discontinuous. Our key insight is that inference delay can be used as decision time. While candidate generation is still underway, candidate selection can reuse the VLA itself to choose the complete action chunk that best fits a later observation. We propose PACT-VLA, a training-free framework that generates candidates from the inference-start observation and selects one using this pre-commit observation. Its scoring function, FlowRes, measures the residual between each candidate's implied flow direction and the velocity predicted by the frozen policy under the pre-commit observation, requiring no separate verifier. A pipelined implementation overlaps observation processing with candidate generation and batches scoring, so selection adds no control-step delay on the evaluated hardware. At a four-step delay, PACT-VLA improves average success by 15.0 percentage points over RTC on Kinetix and by 5.2 points over single-candidate asynchronous execution with GR00T N1.7 on LIBERO, and it further improves existing delay-robust methods. On three real-robot tasks, it raises average success from 60% to 82% over naive asynchronous execution with the same frozen $π_{0.5}$ checkpoint.
tldr: PACT-VLA is a training-free framework that improves the delay-robustness of VLA policies by generating multiple action chunks from a stale observation and using the inference delay as decision time to select the best candidate based on a pre-commit observation, requiring no separate verifier and adding no control-step delay.
tldr_zh: PACT-VLA 是一个无需训练的框架，通过从过时观测生成多个动作块，并利用推理延迟作为决策时间，根据提交前观测选择最佳候选块，提高了 VLA 策略的延迟鲁棒性，无需单独验证器且不增加控制步延迟。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在实际应用中通常采用异步推理的方式进行部署，即在机器人仍在执行上一动作片段的同时生成下一动作片段。当新的动作片段提交执行时，机器人和场景已经发生变化，因此该片段基于的是过时的观测信息，随着推理延迟的增加，任务成功率会显著下降。生成多个候选片段可以让更新的观测信息参与最终选择，但现有的多候选方法要么使用推理起始时的过时观测对候选进行排序，要么在执行过程中反复切换候选，这可能导致执行的动作序列不连续。我们的关键洞察在于，推理延迟本身可以转化为决策时间。在候选生成尚未完成时，候选选择可以复用VLA本身，从较新的观测中选择最适合的完整动作片段。我们提出PACT-VLA，一种无需训练框架，从推理起始观测生成候选，并利用提交前的观测进行选择。其评分函数FlowRes衡量每个候选的隐含流方向与冻结策略在提交前观测下预测速度之间的残差，无需单独的验证器。流水线实现将观测处理与候选生成及批量评分重叠，因此选择过程在评估硬件上不会增加控制步延迟。在四步延迟下，PACT-VLA在Kinetix上相比RTC平均成功率提升15.0个百分点，在LIBERO上相比使用GR00T N1.7的单候选异步执行提升5.2个百分点，并进一步改进了现有的延迟鲁棒方法。在三个真实机器人任务中，使用相同的冻结$π_{0.5}$检查点，PACT-VLA将平均成功率从60%提升至82%，优于朴素异步执行。

title: LocoPilot: Single-Operator Bilateral Teleoperation for Loco-Manipulation Policy Learning
summary: Learning loco-manipulation policies requires demonstrations that capture coordinated base and arm motion on the target embodiment. Robot-free interfaces allow demonstrations to be collected independently of the target robot, increasing flexibility but without directly capturing platform-specific commands, proprioception, and body-mounted observations. On-robot teleoperation allows to capture these signals directly, but requires an interface capable of commanding the complete system concurrently. This paper presents LocoPilot, a single-operator bilateral teleoperation and data-collection framework implemented on a 12-DoF Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with a 6-DoF AgileX Piper L manipulator, an Intel RealSense D435 wrist camera, and an Intel RealSense D405 head camera. A second 6-DoF Piper L arm, used as the leader and two handheld controllers provide simultaneous control of the base, body posture, manipulator, and gripper. The follower arm interaction forces are estimated without a dedicated force/torque sensor and rendered to the operator through a passivity-constrained haptic channel. A ROS~2 pipeline records synchronized multimodal observations together with a unified 11D action shared by teleoperation and policy deployment. Compared to prior work, LocoPilot uniquely unifies robot-in-the-loop legged data collection, force feedback without motion-capture instrumentation, and the same action interface at deployment. We evaluate the interface across multiple loco-manipulation tasks and validate the complete collection-to-deployment pipeline by fine-tuning MolmoAct2 \cite{MOLMO} on pick-and-place demonstrations and deploying on the physical robot without action retargeting or additional inverse kinematics. Code available at: https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/LocoPilot
tldr: LocoPilot presents a single-operator bilateral teleoperation framework for legged loco-manipulation data collection, enabling direct capture of platform-specific commands and proprioception, and validates it by fine-tuning a VLA policy for real-world pick-and-place.
tldr_zh: LocoPilot 提出了一种用于腿式移动操控数据采集的单操作员双边遥操作框架，可直接捕获平台特定的指令和本体感觉，并通过微调 VLA 策略在真实机器人上完成抓取放置任务验证。
summary_zh: 学习移动操控策略需要包含目标本体上基座与手臂协调运动的演示数据。无机器人交互界面允许独立于目标机器人采集演示数据，提高了灵活性，但无法直接捕获平台特定的指令、本体感觉及机体搭载的观测信息。机器人上的遥操作可以直接捕获这些信号，但需要一个能够同时控制完整系统的交互界面。本文提出了LocoPilot，一种单操作员双向遥操作与数据采集框架，实现于配备6自由度AgileX Piper L机械臂、Intel RealSense D435腕部相机和Intel RealSense D405头部相机的12自由度Unitree Go2四足机器人上。第二个6自由度Piper L机械臂作为主臂，配合两个手持控制器，实现对基座、机体姿态、机械臂和夹爪的同步控制。从臂的交互力无需专用力/力矩传感器即可估算，并通过无源性约束的触觉通道反馈给操作员。ROS 2管道记录同步的多模态观测数据，以及遥操作与策略部署共用的统一11维动作表示。与先前工作相比，LocoPilot独特地将机器人参与的回环腿式数据采集、无需动作捕捉设备的力反馈，以及部署时相同的动作接口统一于一体。我们跨多个移动操控任务评估了该交互界面，并通过在拾取放置演示数据上微调MolmoAct2 \cite{MOLMO}，在物理机器人上无需动作重定向或额外逆运动学即可部署，验证了完整的采集到部署管道。代码见：https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/LocoPilot

title: Learning Tactile-Aware Hand Representations from Human Hand-Object Interaction Data
summary: Tactile representation learning for dexterous manipulation often requires substantial robot-side data collection, limiting its scalability across different hands and sensors. We explore whether large-scale human hand-object interaction (HOI) data can provide a useful prior for robotic tactile learning. To this end, we propose HuTact, a framework that pretrains tactile-aware hand representations from human HOI data without requiring real tactile signals during pretraining. HuTact transfers the interaction structure learned from human hand motions to robotic tactile observations and can be further adapted with a small amount of unlabeled robot interaction data. We evaluate HuTact on tactile perception and manipulation tasks, including grasp prediction, slip detection, object classification, and tactile-conditioned policy learning. Across these tasks, human HOI pretraining improves data efficiency and provides a strong initialization for downstream learning. Notably, with HOI pretraining followed by midtraining on unlabeled robot play data, HuTact achieves 88.26% Macro-F1 on grasp prediction using only 25\% of the labeled downstream data, comparable to training from scratch on the full labeled dataset (88.23%). These results suggest that human interaction data can serve as a scalable complementary source for robotic tactile representation learning.
tldr: HuTact pretrains tactile-aware hand representations from large-scale human hand-object interaction data without real tactile signals, enabling efficient adaptation to robotic tactile perception and manipulation tasks with limited labeled data.
tldr_zh: HuTact 从大规模人手-物体交互数据中预训练触觉感知的手部表征，无需真实触觉信号，从而在少量标注数据下有效适应机器人触觉感知与操作任务。
summary_zh: 灵巧操作中的触觉表征学习通常需要大量的机器人侧数据收集，这限制了其在不同机械手和传感器之间的可扩展性。我们探索大规模人类手-物交互数据能否为机器人触觉学习提供有效的先验知识。为此，我们提出HuTact框架，该框架从人类手-物交互数据中预训练触觉感知的手部表征，且预训练阶段无需真实的触觉信号。HuTact将人类手部运动中习得的交互结构迁移至机器人触觉观测，并可通过少量无标注的机器人交互数据进行进一步适配。我们在触觉感知和操作任务上评估HuTact，包括抓取预测、滑移检测、物体分类以及触觉条件策略学习。在这些任务中，人类手-物交互预训练显著提升了数据效率，并为下游学习提供了强初始化。值得注意的是，通过人类手-物交互预训练并结合在无标注机器人播放数据上的中训练，HuTact在仅使用25%标注下游数据的情况下，抓取预测的Macro-F1达到88.26%，与在完整标注数据集上从头训练的88.23%相当。这些结果表明，人类交互数据可作为机器人触觉表征学习中可扩展的补充数据来源。

title: EventSync: Event-Driven Memory Updates for History-Dependent Manipulation
summary: History-dependent robotic manipulation requires task context and interaction history, as the current observation alone is insufficient to determine the next action. Hierarchical frameworks use task memory for high-level subgoal reasoning and low-level policies for execution. However, memory updates require accurate completion assessment: similar observations may correspond to different execution phases, and prematurely recording completion can mislead subsequent subgoal reasoning. We present EventSync, a hierarchical framework that coordinates task reasoning and action execution through event-driven memory updates. A vision-language model generates subgoals from task plans and interaction history, while a vision-language-action model executes them. A lightweight Event Monitor combines visual observations with end-effector trajectories to determine whether the current subgoal is complete. The framework records the current subgoal in its completed-subgoal history and triggers subsequent reasoning only after obtaining completion evidence. With visual history in the executor, EventSync achieves 64.5% overall success on RoboMME, exceeding the best baseline reported in the benchmark by 20.0 percentage points. Further analysis shows that this update mechanism helps build a reliable completed-subgoal history. Experiments on four real-robot tasks with different memory requirements validate the framework's effectiveness in real-world robotic manipulation.
tldr: EventSync introduces a hierarchical framework with event-driven memory updates for history-dependent robot manipulation, using a lightweight event monitor to trigger subgoal reasoning only upon completion evidence, achieving significant success rate improvements over baselines.
tldr_zh: EventSync 提出了一种具有事件驱动内存更新的分层框架，用于历史相关的机器人操作，通过轻量级事件监视器在完成证据出现时才触发子目标推理，显著提高了任务成功率。
summary_zh: 历史依赖的机器人操作需要任务上下文和交互历史，因为仅凭当前观察不足以确定下一步动作。分层框架利用任务记忆进行高层子目标推理，并借助低层策略执行动作。然而，记忆更新需要准确的完成度评估：相似的观察可能对应不同的执行阶段，过早记录完成状态可能误导后续的子目标推理。我们提出了EventSync，一种通过事件驱动的记忆更新来协调任务推理与动作执行的分层框架。视觉-语言模型从任务计划和交互历史中生成子目标，而视觉-语言-动作模型负责执行这些子目标。轻量级事件监控器结合视觉观察与末端执行器轨迹，判断当前子目标是否已完成。框架仅在获得完成证据后，才将当前子目标记录到已完成子目标历史中，并触发后续推理。在执行器中引入视觉历史后，EventSync在RoboMME上取得了64.5%的总体成功率，比基准测试中报告的最佳基线高出20.0个百分点。进一步分析表明，这一更新机制有助于构建可靠的已完成子目标历史。在四种具有不同记忆需求的实际机器人任务上的实验验证了该框架在真实机器人操作中的有效性。

title: What Novice Operators See Changes What the Policy Learns: A User Study of Keypoint Hand Visual Representation for Teleoperated Demonstration
summary: Imitation learning increasingly relies on novice operators, whose demonstrations fall short of experts' in number and inter-trial consistency. Operators act on what they are shown, yet how the rendering of the robot affects their demonstrations, and the policies trained on them, has not been examined. We study this question with PointHand, a teleoperation interface that renders a multi-fingered robot hand as sparse keypoints at its fingertips and joints, the same keypoints a policy can observe. In a simulated mug-in-box task, 18 novices and 4 experts collected 2,200 trials under three renderings: the real shape of the hand, all keypoints emphasized, or the thumb and index finger alone emphasized. The novices shown the thumb and index finger emphasized collected 441 successful demonstrations from 600 trials, against 320 for those shown the real shape. We then trained diffusion policies on these demonstrations, replacing the scene point cloud and proprioceptive state they observe with the hand keypoints and two object keypoints. Within 400 steps these demonstrations went from the weakest of the three novice conditions under the point-cloud policy (46.3%) to the strongest under the keypoint policy (57.3%), a gain of +11.0 percentage points in all five seeds. Those collected with all keypoints emphasized changed by at most +0.7 percentage points, and in no more than three seeds. The value of a demonstration therefore depends on the rendering shown during collection and on what the policy observes together. A shared representation can pay off on both sides, in the number of successful demonstrations and in the success rate of the policy trained on them. Project page: https://omron-sinicx.github.io/point-hand/
tldr: This paper studies how the visual rendering of a robot hand during teleoperated demonstration collection affects both the quality of demonstrations from novice operators and the performance of policies trained on them, finding that a shared keypoint representation improves both demonstration success rates and downstream policy success.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了遥操作示范采集中机器人手部视觉渲染方式如何影响新手操作者的示范质量以及后续策略的性能，发现共享关键点表示能同时提高示范成功率和下游策略成功率。
summary_zh: 模仿学习日益依赖于新手操作员，而他们的示范在数量上和试验间一致性上均不及专家。操作员依据所见进行操作，然而机器人渲染方式如何影响他们的示范以及基于这些示范训练的策略，尚未得到研究。我们通过PointHand这一遥操作界面来探究此问题，该界面将多指机器人手渲染为指尖和关节处的稀疏关键点，即策略可观察到的同一组关键点。在模拟的杯子放入盒子任务中，18名新手和4名专家在三种渲染条件下收集了2,200次试验：手的真实形状、全部关键点突出显示、或仅突出显示拇指和食指。看到拇指和食指突出显示的新手在600次试验中收集了441次成功示范，而看到真实形状的新手则收集了320次成功示范。随后我们基于这些示范训练扩散策略，将策略观察的场景点云和本体感觉状态替换为手部关键点和两个物体关键点。在400步训练内，这些示范在点云策略下从三种新手条件中最弱（46.3%）转变为关键点策略下最强（57.3%），在所有五个随机种子中均获得+11.0个百分点的提升。全部关键点突出显示条件下收集的示范变化最多不超过+0.7个百分点，且仅在不超过三个种子中有所提升。因此，示范的价值既取决于收集过程中展示的渲染方式，也取决于策略共同观察的内容。共享表示可在两方面带来收益：成功示范的数量以及基于这些示范训练的策略的成功率。项目页面：https://omron-sinicx.github.io/point-hand/

title: Frontier LLMs Enter the World of Robotics: A Cross-Model Evaluation on RoboColiseum
summary: Recent studies have explored the potential of multimodal large language models for robot control, yet the models' embodied capabilities remain insufficiently characterized across models, tasks, and execution settings. We conduct a multidimensional comparative evaluation on RoboColiseum across four tracks: Instruction Following, Spatial Reasoning, General Manipulation, and Robustness. We implement Agent2Act, a control harness that integrates GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, and Gemini 4 Argon into the evaluation environment through shared observation, action execution, and feedback interfaces. Under common task settings and scoring criteria, all four models exhibit a consistent capability profile: high instruction-following scores, with three approaching perfect performance; strong spatial reasoning; and general manipulation scores below those of the other three tracks. Within the evaluated configurations, Astra leads instruction following and robustness, while Opus leads spatial reasoning, general manipulation, and overall performance. These results reveal complementary strengths across models and a persistent gap between task understanding and reliable physical execution. Component comparisons on selected tasks further show that harness design affects task success, planning cost, and execution time. Additionally, case studies with Astra examine whole-body coordination, manipulation across robot embodiments, precision manipulation, dexterous-hand manipulation, and real-robot tasks, providing further insight into the model's capabilities and limitations across embodied tasks.
tldr: This paper evaluates frontier multimodal LLMs on robot control tasks within the RoboColiseum benchmark, using a unified control harness across instruction following, spatial reasoning, manipulation, and robustness, revealing complementary strengths and persistent gaps between task understanding and physical execution.
tldr_zh: 本文在RoboColiseum基准上评估了前沿多模态大模型的机器人控制能力，使用统一的控制框架覆盖指令跟随、空间推理、操作和鲁棒性等任务，揭示了各模型的互补优势以及任务理解与物理执行之间的持续差距。
summary_zh: 近期研究已探索多模态大语言模型在机器人控制中的潜力，然而，这些模型的具身能力在不同模型、任务及执行场景中的表征仍不充分。我们在RoboColiseum平台上开展了涵盖四个轨道的多维比较评估：指令遵循、空间推理、通用操作及鲁棒性。我们实现了Agent2Act，一个控制框架，通过共享观测、动作执行及反馈接口，将GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol、Claude Opus 5.5和Gemini 4 Argon集成到评估环境中。在统一的任务设置和评分标准下，四个模型展现出一致的能力特征：指令遵循得分高，其中三个模型接近完美表现；空间推理能力强；而通用操作得分低于其他三个轨道。在所评估的配置中，Astra在指令遵循和鲁棒性方面领先，而Opus在空间推理、通用操作及整体性能上居首。这些结果揭示了模型之间互补的优势，以及任务理解与可靠物理执行之间持续存在的差距。在选定任务上的组件比较进一步表明，框架设计会影响任务成功率、规划成本及执行时间。此外，针对Astra的案例研究考察了全身协调、跨机器人形态的操作、精细操作、灵巧手操作及真实机器人任务，从而更深入地揭示了该模型在各类具身任务中的能力与局限。

title: RoboCasa-Shift: Stage-Aware Robustness Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Policies in Long-Horizon Household Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) robustness is commonly summarized by aggregate task success, which obscures how individual executions change under distribution shifts and where failures emerge in long-horizon tasks. We introduce \textbf{RoboCasa-Shift}, a diagnostic robustness benchmark built on RoboCasa365 that combines controlled single-factor shifts, matched clean-perturbed rollouts in which each pair shares the same underlying settings and differs only in the target shift, and simulator-grounded stage-aware diagnostics. We evaluate GR00T N1.5 on four long-horizon tasks that pass a predefined clean-performance gate under four perturbation factors and three calibrated severity levels, including conditions that drive the evaluated policy to complete task failure, totaling 1,040 formal rollouts. Robustness responses vary substantially across factors and tasks, and increasing severity does not always produce monotonic degradation. For example, one camera condition yields $Δ\mathrm{SR}=0$ despite 8 of 80 matched episodes changing outcome. Stage-aware analysis further shows that the same end-to-end degradation can correspond to different execution-depth profiles. Camera $L_2$ and Gaussian blur $L_1$ both yield $Δ\mathrm{SR}=0.188$, yet their first-stage failure rates are 19.0\% and 36.4\%, respectively. Our findings suggest that VLA robustness should be viewed as a multi-dimensional property of execution rather than a single end-to-end performance measure, motivating evaluation protocols that jointly capture outcome degradation, paired outcome sensitivity, and failure progression. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/HaochengWang23/RoboCasa-Shift.
tldr: This paper introduces RoboCasa-Shift, a diagnostic robustness benchmark for evaluating VLA policies under controlled distribution shifts in long-horizon household manipulation, revealing that robustness is multi-dimensional and not captured by aggregate success rates alone.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 RoboCasa-Shift，一个用于在长时程家庭操作任务中评估 VLA 策略在受控分布偏移下鲁棒性的诊断基准，揭示了鲁棒性是多维度的，不能仅由总体成功率衡量。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的鲁棒性通常以总体任务成功率来概括，但这种做法掩盖了在分布偏移下各次执行结果的变化，以及长时程任务中失败究竟在何处出现。我们提出 \textbf{RoboCasa-Shift}，一个基于 RoboCasa365 构建的诊断性鲁棒性基准，它结合了受控的单因素偏移、匹配的干净-扰动 rollout（每对 rollout 共享相同的底层设置，仅目标偏移不同），以及基于仿真器的分阶段诊断。我们在四项通过预定义干净性能门槛的长时程任务上评估 GR00T N1.5，涵盖四种扰动因素和三个校准严重级别，包括使被评估策略完全任务失败的条件，总共有 1,040 次正式 rollout。鲁棒性响应在不同因素和任务间差异显著，且严重程度的增加并不总是带来单调的性能退化。例如，在某种相机条件下，尽管 80 个匹配回合中有 8 个结果发生变化，$\Delta\mathrm{SR}$ 仍为 0。分阶段分析进一步表明，相同的端到端性能退化可能对应不同的执行深度分布。相机 $L_2$ 扰动与高斯模糊 $L_1$ 扰动均产生 $\Delta\mathrm{SR}=0.188$，但二者的第一阶段失败率分别为 19.0\% 和 36.4\%。我们的研究结果表明，VLA 鲁棒性应被视为执行过程的多维属性，而非单一的端到端性能指标，因此需要同时捕捉结果退化、配对结果敏感性以及失败进展的联合评估协议。代码已公开于 https://github.com/HaochengWang23/RoboCasa-Shift。

title: Multi-View Latent Action Pretraining for Cross-Embodiment Robot Learning from Videos
summary: Action-free videos are an appealing substitute for costly teleoperated data. Latent action models (LAMs) turn videos into a supervision signal by inferring abstract actions between frames. Existing LAMs observe a single camera view, which resolves 6D robot actions only ambiguously missing out-of-plane movements and potential occlusions. We propose a LAM that ingests synchronized multi-camera views using cross-attention to resolve depth and occlusions before compressing them into latent actions. The latent actions are fed into a policy in which a latent expert and an action expert are coupled by sequential flow matching around a frozen VLM backbone. We further evaluate in strict cross-embodiment settings where task-specific demonstrations come from other embodiments. We show that dual-view LAM pretraining improves the decodability of ground-truth 6D actions by 17% compared to single-view, while scaling single-view data by two orders of magnitude is not sufficient to fully recover out-of-plane motions. The downstream policy improves success rate by +13.5% compared to +6.2% for single-view LAM. A single cross-embodiment is sufficient for skill transfer, and adding a second viewpoint outperforms adding up to four further embodiments. The results transfer to hardware where demonstrations come from a human hand improving success rate by +20% over action-only policies in 850 rollouts. We show that video and robot data are complementary, and that benefits of learning from video are task-dependent. Website: https://learnsyslab.github.io/multiview_latent_action_pretraining/
tldr: This paper proposes a multi-view latent action model that uses cross-attention to fuse synchronized camera views, improving 6D action decodability and cross-embodiment policy learning from action-free videos, with gains demonstrated in simulation and real-robot rollouts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种多视角隐动作模型，通过交叉注意力融合同步多相机视图，提高从无动作视频中解码6D动作的能力，并在跨本体策略学习中取得显著提升，仿真和真实机器人实验均验证了有效性。
summary_zh: 无动作视频是昂贵遥操作数据的一种有吸引力的替代品。潜在动作模型（LAMs）通过推断帧之间的抽象动作，将视频转化为监督信号。现有的LAMs仅观察单一摄像头视角，这使得6D机器人动作的解析存在模糊性，无法捕捉平面外运动及潜在的遮挡问题。我们提出了一种LAM模型，该模型利用交叉注意力机制融合多摄像头同步视角，在将其压缩为潜在动作之前解决深度和遮挡问题。潜在动作被输入到一个策略中，在该策略中，潜在专家和动作专家通过围绕冻结的VLM主干网络的序列流匹配进行耦合。我们进一步在严格的跨具身设置中进行了评估，其中任务特定的演示来自其他具身。我们证明，与单视角相比，双视角LAM预训练将真实6D动作的可解码性提高了17%，而将单视角数据扩展两个数量级仍不足以完全恢复平面外运动。下游策略的成功率提升至+13.5%，而单视角LAM仅为+6.2%。单个跨具身数据足以实现技能迁移，且增加第二个视角优于增加多达四个额外具身。这些结果也迁移到了硬件实验中，在850次实际部署中，使用人类手部演示的策略相比仅基于动作的策略成功率提高了+20%。我们表明视频和机器人数据是互补的，且从视频中学习的收益取决于具体任务。网站：https://learnsyslab.github.io/multiview_latent_action_pretraining/

title: RoboJudge: Multimodal Language Models as Judges for Embodied Video Generation
summary: Video generation models are promising foundations for embodied world models, but only if their generated rollouts are physically valid and faithful to task instructions. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to judge these properties, yet their agreement with human judgments on embodied videos has not been systematically evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce RoboJudge-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs as judges of embodied video generation. The benchmark measures two fundamental dimensions, Physical Adherence and Instruction Alignment, across 800 human-annotated videos from 8 source corpora and 10 video generators, spanning grippers, human hands, and dexterous hands. Experiments reveal uneven alignment between existing judges and human ratings: general-purpose MLLMs show lower agreement on physical adherence, while specialized video judges designed for general-domain physical reasoning do not consistently transfer to embodied scenarios. Motivated by these findings, we construct RoboJudge-Train, comprising 12K videos annotated with 25K human-verified scores and model-assisted rationales for Physical Adherence and Instruction Alignment. We fine-tune a 9B MLLM on this dataset with supervised learning followed by reinforcement learning, yielding RoboJudge-9B. Among the model judges evaluated on RoboJudge-Bench, RoboJudge-9B achieves the highest overall agreement, reaching a Pearson correlation of 0.719 with a statistically significant 0.089 gain over Gemini-3.7-Flash, the best-performing proprietary baseline in our evaluation. Training on RoboJudge-Train also yields gains on external benchmarks, including VideoPhy2 and Physion-Eval. We further use RoboJudge-9B as a downstream evaluator to benchmark video generation models according to Physical Adherence and Instruction Alignment.
tldr: This paper introduces RoboJudge-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs as judges of embodied video generation, and RoboJudge-9B, a fine-tuned MLLM that achieves the highest agreement with human judgments on physical adherence and instruction alignment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了RoboJudge-Bench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型作为具身视频生成评判者的能力，并训练了RoboJudge-9B模型，在物理一致性和指令对齐方面与人类判断的一致性最高。
summary_zh: 视频生成模型是具身世界模型的有力基础，但前提是其生成的推演序列在物理上有效且忠实于任务指令。多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）正越来越多地被用于评判这些属性，然而它们与人类在具身视频评判上的一致性尚未得到系统评估。为填补这一空白，我们提出了RoboJudge-Bench，一个用于评估MLLMs作为具身视频生成评判者的基准。该基准从8个源语料库和10个视频生成器中，对800个经过人工标注的视频，衡量两个基本维度：物理遵从性和指令对齐性。实验揭示了现有评判者与人类评分之间的不一致性：通用型MLLMs在物理遵从性上的一致性较低，而为通用领域物理推理设计的专用视频评判者，在迁移到具身场景时并不能持续保持其性能。基于这些发现，我们构建了RoboJudge-Train，包含12K个视频，配有25K个人工验证的评分以及用于物理遵从性和指令对齐性的模型辅助推理依据。我们通过监督学习结合强化学习，在该数据集上微调了一个9B参数的MLLM，得到RoboJudge-9B。在RoboJudge-Bench上评估的所有模型评判者中，RoboJudge-9B取得了最高的总体一致性，皮尔逊相关系数达到0.719，相较于我们评估中表现最佳的商业基线Gemini-3.7-Flash，统计上显著提升了0.089。在RoboJudge-Train上的训练还为外部基准带来了增益，包括VideoPhy2和Physion-Eval。我们进一步将RoboJudge-9B作为下游评估器，根据物理遵从性和指令对齐性对视频生成模型进行基准测试。

title: AWLS: Advantage-Weighted Latent Steering for One-Step Generative Robotic Manipulation Policies
summary: Human-collected real-world robotic manipulation demonstrations often contain mixed-quality trajectories, including hesitant, indirect, or inefficient action segments. While diffusion- and flow-based policies can model such multimodal data, standard behavior cloning (BC) assigns equal likelihood to all demonstrated actions and may therefore reproduce suboptimal modes. Offline RL value estimates offer a natural signal for biasing policies toward higher-value behavioral modes, but directly fine-tuning the generative policy or using critic gradients for policy steering can amplify critic errors and induce prior drift. We propose Advantage-Weighted Latent Steering (AWLS), an offline post-training method for improving frozen one-step generative manipulation policies without updating their decoders. AWLS learns a residual noise shaper, an observation-conditioned residual correction to the policy's latent noise, and trains it with an advantage-weighted action reconstruction objective. The advantages are detached, scale-normalized, and used only as supervised weights on demonstrated actions, avoiding critic-gradient policy updates while preserving fast single-step inference. We further introduce a rollout-free decoder-sensitivity criterion for selecting pretrained checkpoints that remain responsive to latent-noise perturbations. Experiments on simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks with clean and mixed-quality demonstrations show that AWLS improves over the frozen base policy while limiting drift from the pretrained behavior prior. Project page: https://awls-corl2026.github.io/
tldr: AWLS is a post-training method that improves frozen one-step generative robotic manipulation policies by shaping latent noise with advantage-weighted reconstruction, avoiding critic-gradient updates and preserving inference speed.
tldr_zh: AWLS 是一种后训练方法，通过优势加权重建来调整冻结的单步生成式机器人操作策略的潜噪声，避免了评论家梯度更新并保持了推理速度。
summary_zh: 人工采集的真实世界机器人操作演示数据常包含质量参差不齐的轨迹，其中不乏犹豫、迂回或低效的动作片段。虽然基于扩散和流匹配的策略能够建模此类多模态数据，但标准行为克隆（BC）对所有演示动作赋予相同似然，因此可能复现次优模态。离线强化学习的价值估计为引导策略偏向高价值行为模态提供了天然信号，但直接微调生成式策略或利用评论家梯度进行策略导向可能放大评论家误差并引发先验漂移。我们提出优势加权潜在引导（AWLS）——一种离线后训练方法，用于在不更新解码器的情况下改进冻结的单步生成式操作策略。AWLS学习一个残差噪声整形器，即对策略潜在噪声的观测条件残差修正，并通过优势加权动作重建目标进行训练。优势值被分离处理、尺度归一化，且仅作为演示动作上的监督权重，从而避免评论家梯度策略更新，同时保持快速单步推理。我们进一步提出一种无需 rollout 的解码器敏感性准则，用于筛选对潜在噪声扰动保持响应的预训练检查点。在仿真和真实机器人操作任务上，使用干净与混合质量演示的实验表明，AWLS在冻结基策略基础上取得改进，同时限制了对预训练行为先验的漂移。项目页面：https://awls-corl2026.github.io/

title: CovNav: Conformal Prediction-Guided Adaptive Inference for Object Goal Navigation
summary: In object goal navigation (ObjectNav), an embodied agent must find a target object (e.g., "find a bed") in a previously unseen environment, relying on spatial commonsense such as object co-occurrence. Large Language Models (LLMs) encode this commonsense, but deploying them on robots exposes a trade-off between reasoning quality and efficiency: cloud-based models incur latency and privacy risks, whereas small on-device LLMs are fast but prone to hallucinated spatial judgments. Hybrid reasoning LLMs offer both a fast non-thinking mode and a slow thinking mode, which raises a key question for embodied agents: when is slow thinking worth its cost? We propose CovNav, a training-free framework that answers this question with Conformal Prediction (CP), turning dual-process (System 1 / System 2) inference into an uncertainty-aware decision. Much like recent decision models such as Jev, CovNav casts each spatial query as a structured binary decision rather than free-form generation: a local LLM in fast mode judges whether the target is likely near an observed object, CP converts its token probabilities into a prediction set, and only ambiguous queries are escalated to slow chain-of-thought reasoning. The object-pair formulation keeps calibration tractable and supports open-set objects through off-the-shelf detectors. Experiments on Gibson and HM3D show that CovNav surpasses the strongest zero-shot baseline by 0.8 and 1.7 percentage points in success rate on HM3D v1 and v2, while invoking slow reasoning for only 12.4% of queries and retaining most of the gain of always-on thinking at a fraction of its latency. Real-robot experiments on a TurtleBot 4 further validate the approach. CovNav shows how calibrated uncertainty can decide when an embodied agent should think slowly, offering a principled form of adaptive test-time reasoning for LLM-based robots.
tldr: CovNav introduces a conformal prediction-guided framework that adaptively decides when an embodied agent should use slow chain-of-thought reasoning from a hybrid LLM during object goal navigation, improving success on Gibson and HM3D with low reasoning overhead and validating on a real TurtleBot 4.
tldr_zh: CovNav 提出一种基于保形预测的框架，在物体目标导航中自适应决定何时使用混合 LLM 的慢速推理模式，在 Gibson 和 HM3D 上提升成功率并以较低开销在真实 TurtleBot 4 上验证。
summary_zh: 在目标目标导航（ObjectNav）任务中，具身智能体必须在未见过的环境中找到目标物体（例如“找到一张床”），这依赖于物体共现等空间常识。大语言模型（LLMs）编码了这类常识，但在机器人上部署它们时，需要在推理质量与效率之间做出权衡：基于云的模型会带来延迟和隐私风险，而设备端的小型LLM虽然速度快，却容易产生幻觉式的空间判断。混合推理LLM同时提供快速非思考模式和缓慢思考模式，这给具身智能体带来了一个关键问题：何时值得为缓慢思考付出代价？我们提出CovNav，一个无需训练且利用共形预测（CP）回答该问题的框架，将双过程（系统1/系统2）推理转化为不确定性感知的决策。与Jev等近期决策模型类似，CovNav将每个空间查询视为结构化二元决策而非自由形式生成：本地LLM在快速模式下判断目标是否可能靠近某个已观察物体，CP将其词元概率转换为预测集，仅将模糊查询升级为缓慢的链式思维推理。物体配对公式保证了校准的可操作性，并可通过现成检测器支持开放集物体。在Gibson和HM3D上的实验表明，CovNav在HM3D v1和v2上的成功率分别超过最强零样本基线0.8和1.7个百分点，同时仅对12.4%的查询调用缓慢推理，并以极低的延迟保留了常开思维的大部分收益。TurtleBot 4上的真实机器人实验进一步验证了该方法。CovNav展示了校准后的不确定性如何决定具身智能体何时应进行缓慢思考，为基于LLM的机器人提供了一种原则性的自适应测试时推理形式。

title: PLaCA: Learning Patch-Level Future Latent Change for Action Generation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but effective manipulation also requires anticipating how the environment will change. Existing world-action models explore future image prediction and latent dynamics modeling. However, generating complete future images can be computationally expensive, while highly compressed latent representations may obscure local changes. To address these challenges, we propose PLaCA, a world-to-action framework built around future latent change. PLaCA directly predicts spatially structured patch-level future latent change from the current multimodal input, preserving local information about expected environmental changes. We introduce patch-level change-aware supervision to emphasize regions undergoing larger changes and a future-to-action interface that explicitly incorporates predicted future latent change into action generation. Experiments on LIBERO-Long show that PLaCA achieves a 79.0% success rate, improving upon the Action-only baseline by 5.0 percentage points.
